title: Canonical Powerhouse daily blog slug boundary
root_cause: Exporter slugify stripped punctuation before truncating to 70 characters, allowing the 70th character to be a hyphen; the protected Python publication generator rejected it as INVALID_SLUG.
impact: One approved blog was not published by the existing daily GitHub publisher; generation and obligation truth must not be overwritten or marked delivered.
failed_approaches: Ignoring INVALID_SLUG or waiving Python publication validation
Changing an already published canonical provider path
fix: Strip trailing hyphens again after 70-character truncation. Reject malformed manually approved SEO slugs at the exporter before publication, preserving exact provider lineage.
prevention_rule: Every generated slug must match the writer regex after truncation; explicit approved slugs and provider receipts remain immutable; source must pass protected CI, deployment and one real same-day readback.

shadow: validate exact previously failing synthetic title and preserved lineage rejection
negative_canary: explicit malformed approved slug must return 409; never publish by bypassing validity checks
